newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish net reserves fall to $20.76 bln Apr 1-20. [CORRECTED 19:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Polish net reserves fall to $20.76 bln Apr 1-20. [CORRECTED 19:40 GMT]

text.p: Polish net foreign currency reserves fell by $335 million in April 1-20 to $20.759 billion (corrects from $21.759 billion) and were $832 million lower than at the end of April 1996, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said the net reserves fell $908 million in the January-April 20 period.
POLISH RESERVES (bln dollars) APRIL 20 MARCH FEB APRIL 96
NOTE - Figures in billions of dollars. Official reserves are those held by the state. Net reserves mean the total amount of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
